The separate app/inference_api.py INFERENCE_LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.55 marks its low_confidence diagnostic field only; it does not override result_state. Web must consume result_state and must not recompute state in the browser. No model, threshold, gate, or routing value is changed by this contract closure.
